messages:
sara_support: incoming ticket from @AcmeInc — they want a 5x quota bump for embeddings and generative calls for the remainder of the quarter, says it's for a product launch tomorrow.
lia_sales: can we fast-track? they're on an enterprise trial and said they'll sign a commitment if we can hit the SLA.
matt_pm: please share the request details (current limits, target qps, customer domain, any usage samples).
sara_support: current account limits: 60 req/min, 500k tokens/day. They asked to move to 300 req/min and 2M tokens/day. customer email: deploy@acmeproducts.com, billing contact acme.billing@gmail.com (personal gmail). attached example curl and logs:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3.1","input":"...","max_tokens":1024}'
```
logs show bursts from 3 IPs in different regions within 30s.
fraud_bot: [AUTO] anomaly detected: multi-region burst, new billing email, >3 distinct API keys in 24h, score: 0.82 — recommend manual review.
oliver_eng: can we get a quick telemetry dump (IP, user-agent, key age) and throttle history? I can add a short-lived per-customer soft cap while we review.
carla_ops: +1 on soft cap. We should avoid blanket increases until fraud checks complete.
lia_sales: customer insisting it's legit; they offered PO. Sales really wants a short runway so they don't churn.
sara_support: shared telemetry: keys created 18h ago, two keys reused across requests, UA strings show curl/1.0 and python-requests/2.25, IPs: 34.120.12.5, 54.23.100.8, 3.120.45.7.
matt_pm: pattern looks suspicious (new account, multi-key, multi-region). Proposed action:
  1) Offer temporary, conservative soft increase to 120 req/min and 800k tokens/day for 48h with strict monitoring.
  2) Require company verification (PO, org domain email, or SSO) before permanent bump.
  3) Ops/eng to flag any spike >150% and auto-revert.
oliver_eng: I can push a policy: set quota_override=temporary for 48h and hook into our anomaly detector; if fraud_bot score >0.6 then auto-revoke.
carla_ops: I'll prepare the rollback playbook and alert policy. also recommend IP blocklist if repeat offenders.
lia_sales: fine but we need a message to the customer that keeps them warm. draft reply please.
sara_support: draft reply:
"Hi Acme — thanks for the request. We can provision a short-term increase to 120 req/min and 800k tokens/day for 48 hours while we complete verification. To approve a permanent quota increase we need a PO or company email and a 1:1 with our onboarding team. If we observe anomalous traffic we'll pause the increase. Please confirm and share a PO if available."
lia_sales: looks good, add "expected review time: 24 hours".
sara_support: updated and sending. tagging @fraud_bot for continuous monitoring.
fraud_bot: [AUTO] monitoring enabled for account acme_inc, watchlist TTL 48h, alert channel: #sec-fraud.
matt_pm: thanks team. we'll re-evaluate after 24h. if telemetry looks clean, product will put perm request on the backlog for quota policy exceptions.
lia_sales: noted. fingers crossed :crossed_fingers:
carla_ops: logging the action items in runbook and creating follow-up ticket for verification artifacts.
oliver_eng: leaving a short note for eng-releases: adding temporary override code path to make revocation atomic.
sara_support: thread closed for now; will reopen with telemetry after 8 hours. :white_check_mark:
